```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(knitr)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "results/prior_sensitivity")
prior_models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models/prior_sensitivity_test")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures/prior_sensitivity")

set.seed(7386)

demographics <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "demographics.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```



## Data preparation
```{r}
dem_analytic <- demographics %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")

analytic_ids <- dem_analytic %>%
  distinct(id)

sound_analytic <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(analytic_ids, by = "id")

bb_data <- sound_analytic %>%
  filter(responder_gender %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(sound_event_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(press_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    y = ifelse(responder_gender == "Female", 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, press_number, y)

bb_wide <- bb_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = press_number, values_from = y) %>%
  arrange(id)

bb_mat <- bb_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-id) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(bb_mat) <- "numeric"

dim(bb_mat)

markov_data <- sound_analytic %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  arrange(sound_event_order, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(event_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      responder_gender == "none" ~ 1,
      responder_gender == "Male" ~ 2,
      responder_gender == "Female" ~ 3
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, event_number, response)

markov_wide <- markov_data %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = event_number, values_from = response) %>%
  arrange(id)

markov_mat <- markov_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(-id) %>%
  as.matrix()

storage.mode(markov_mat) <- "numeric"
```

## Hierarchical Beta-Bernoulli

```{r}
data_list_bb <- list(
  N = nrow(bb_mat),
  y = bb_mat
)

params_bb <- c("mu", "nu", "pop_p", "p", "mu_prior", "nu_prior", "pop_p_prior", "p_prior")

if (file.exists(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_original.rds"))) {
  samples_bb_orig <- readRDS(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_original.rds"))
} else {
  samples_bb_orig <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_bb,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_bb,
    model.file = file.path(prior_models_path, "s1_hier_beta_bernoulli_original.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 20000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_bb_orig, file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_original.rds"))
}


if (file.exists(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_beta22.rds"))) {
  samples_bb_beta22 <- readRDS(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_beta22.rds"))
} else {
  samples_bb_beta22 <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_bb,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_bb,
    model.file = file.path(prior_models_path, "s1_hier_beta_bernoulli_beta22.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 20000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_bb_beta22, file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_beta22.rds"))
}


if (file.exists(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_nu20.rds"))) {
  samples_bb_nu20 <- readRDS(file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_nu20.rds"))
} else {
  samples_bb_nu20 <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_bb,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save = params_bb,
    model.file = file.path(prior_models_path, "s1_hier_beta_bernoulli_nu20.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 20000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1
  )
  saveRDS(samples_bb_nu20, file.path(results_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_nu20.rds"))
}
```

### Posterior summaries and DIC
```{r}
table_bb_summary <- bind_rows(
  extract_summary(samples_bb_orig, "original", c("mu", "nu")),
  extract_summary(samples_bb_beta22, "beta22", c("mu", "nu")),
  extract_summary(samples_bb_nu20, "nu20", c("mu", "nu"))
)

table_bb_dic <- tibble(
  model = c("original", "beta22", "nu20"),
  dic = c(
    samples_bb_orig$BUGSoutput$DIC,
    samples_bb_beta22$BUGSoutput$DIC,
    samples_bb_nu20$BUGSoutput$DIC
  ),
  pD = c(
    samples_bb_orig$BUGSoutput$pD,
    samples_bb_beta22$BUGSoutput$pD,
    samples_bb_nu20$BUGSoutput$pD
  )
)

kable(table_bb_summary, digits = 3)
kable(table_bb_dic, digits = 2)
```

### Prior vs posterior across Beta-Bernoulli sensitivity conditions
```{r}
draws_bb_orig <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_bb_orig))
draws_bb_beta22 <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_bb_beta22))
draws_bb_nu20 <- as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_bb_nu20))

bb_pp_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "mu"], source = "posterior", model = "original", parameter = "mu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "mu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "original", parameter = "mu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "mu"], source = "posterior", model = "beta22", parameter = "mu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "mu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "beta22", parameter = "mu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "mu"], source = "posterior", model = "nu20", parameter = "mu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "mu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "nu20", parameter = "mu"),

  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "nu"], source = "posterior", model = "original", parameter = "nu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "nu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "original", parameter = "nu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "nu"], source = "posterior", model = "beta22", parameter = "nu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "nu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "beta22", parameter = "nu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "nu"], source = "posterior", model = "nu20", parameter = "nu"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "nu_prior"], source = "prior", model = "nu20", parameter = "nu"),

  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "pop_p"], source = "posterior", model = "original", parameter = "pop_p"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_orig[, "pop_p_prior"], source = "prior", model = "original", parameter = "pop_p"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "pop_p"], source = "posterior", model = "beta22", parameter = "pop_p"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_beta22[, "pop_p_prior"], source = "prior", model = "beta22", parameter = "pop_p"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "pop_p"], source = "posterior", model = "nu20", parameter = "pop_p"),
  tibble(value = draws_bb_nu20[, "pop_p_prior"], source = "prior", model = "nu20", parameter = "pop_p")
) %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = factor(parameter, levels = c("mu", "nu", "pop_p"),
                       labels = c("Population mean", "Concentration", "Population distribution draw")),
    model = factor(model, levels = c("original", "beta22", "nu20"))
  )

plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_prior_sens_beta_bernoulli_prior_posterior.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  p_bb_prior_post_sens <- ggplot(bb_pp_df, aes(value, fill = source, colour = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.22, linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_grid(parameter ~ model, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Hierarchical Beta-Bernoulli: prior vs posterior across sensitivity conditions",
      x = "Value",
      y = "Density",
      fill = NULL,
      colour = NULL
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_bb_prior_post_sens,
    width = 10,
    height = 8,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```


## Hierarchical first-order Markov

```{r}
)

params_markov <- c(
```


#### Population transition summaries
```{r}
table_markov_pool <- bind_rows(
  extract_theta_summary(samples_markov_mult1, "mult1"),
  extract_theta_summary(samples_markov_mult3, "mult3"),

kable(table_markov_pool, digits = 3)
```

#### Overlaid posterior transition densities
```{r}
theta_markov_pool_draws <- bind_rows(
  extract_theta_draws(samples_markov_mult1, "mult1"),
  extract_theta_draws(samples_markov_mult3, "mult3"),
  extract_theta_draws(samples_markov_mult10, "mult10")
)

theta_markov_pool_prior_draws <- bind_rows(
  extract_theta_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult1, "mult1"),
  extract_theta_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult3, "mult3"),
  extract_theta_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult10, "mult10")
)


plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_prior_sens_markov_pool_prior_posterior.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  p_markov_pool_overlay <- ggplot() +
    geom_density(
      data = theta_markov_pool_draws,
      aes(x = value, fill = to),
      alpha = 0.35
    ) +
    geom_density(
      data = theta_markov_pool_prior_draws,
      aes(x = value, colour = to),
      fill = NA,
      linetype = 2,
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +
  
    facet_grid(from ~ model) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Hierarchical Markov: pooling sensitivity",
      subtitle = "Dashed lines = monitored prior draws; filled densities = posterior draws",
      x = "Transition probability",
      y = "Density"
    )

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_pool_overlay,
    width = 10,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```

```{r}
plot_png_path <- file.path(figure_path, "s1_prior_sens_markov_dyad_prior_posterior.png")

if (file.exists(plot_png_path)) {
  show_or_save_ggplot(plot_png_path = plot_png_path)
} else {
  selected_dyads <- c(1, 10, 25, 40)

  theta_p_post_compare <- bind_rows(
    extract_theta_p_draws(samples_markov_mult1, "mult1"),
    extract_theta_p_draws(samples_markov_mult3, "mult3"),
    extract_theta_p_draws(samples_markov_mult10, "mult10")
  ) %>%
    filter(
      dyad %in% selected_dyads,
      (from == "none" & to == "none") |
        (from == "male" & to == "male") |
        (from == "female" & to == "female")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      transition = paste0(from, " → ", to),
      source = "posterior"
    )

  theta_p_prior_compare <- bind_rows(
    extract_theta_p_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult1, "mult1"),
    extract_theta_p_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult3, "mult3"),
    extract_theta_p_prior_draws(samples_markov_mult10, "mult10")
  ) %>%
    filter(
      dyad %in% selected_dyads,
      (from == "none" & to == "none") |
        (from == "male" & to == "male") |
        (from == "female" & to == "female")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      transition = paste0(from, " → ", to),
      source = "prior"
    )

  p_markov_dyad_sens <- bind_rows(theta_p_post_compare, theta_p_prior_compare) %>%
    ggplot(aes(value, colour = model, fill = model, linetype = source)) +
    geom_density(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.4) +
    facet_grid(transition ~ dyad, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Hierarchical first-order Markov: dyad-level prior vs posterior sensitivity",
      subtitle = "Solid = posterior, dashed = monitored prior draws",
      x = "Dyad-level transition probability",
      y = "Density",
      colour = "Pooling prior",
      fill = "Pooling prior",
      linetype = NULL
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(prior = 2, posterior = 1))

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_markov_dyad_sens,
    width = 11,
    height = 7,
    dpi = 300
  )
}
```
